QUOTE: "transfer accuracy of 0.74" METRIC: transfer_acc ISSUE: transfer_acc is 0.73; 0.74 is the strong-model ceiling accuracy (strong_acc).
QUOTE: "this is a gain well outside the standard error" METRIC: baseline_pgr ISSUE: No standard error is reported for the baseline PGR, so the significance of the difference cannot be established from the data.
